Over this comes the lesson target のだろうか: the だろう (presumptive form of だ) expresses conjecture ('I wonder / it must be') and the final か turns the question into a reflection/doubt of the speaker, not a direct question to another person.

translation_literal.en: The coat, I'm wearing it right now.
translation_literal.pt-BR: O casaco, agora, está vestindo no momento (é).

structure_explanation.en: The target is the construction 〜ているところだ, which indicates that the action is happening at this very moment. Here the object 上着 ('jacket') is marked by を, 今 ('now') sets the time, and the verb 着る appears in the form 着ている ('to be putting on'). ところだ is added to emphasize 'right at the moment of putting it on'.

Aqui o objeto 上着 ('casaco') é marcado por を, 今 ('agora') situa o tempo, e o verbo 着る aparece na forma 着ている ('estar vestindo'). Adiciona-se ところだ para enfatizar 'bem no momento em que está vestindo'.
